items.html: And we return to the matter: the Mem of the Tzelem is the clothing of the Mochin in the first four of Tevuna, and the Lamed of the Tzelem is the second descent of the Mochin in their clothing in the HGT of Tevuna, and they are only three Sefirot, HGT, each one of the ten — these are the Lamed. For the garments are only the three HGT; although the Mochin are four, they are covered within them, and only the garments are discernible, which are three. And although they are only two and a half Sefirot, still they are called Lamed; and the matter is that half a Sefira of the Tifferet of Tevuna is not part of the Lamed of the Tzelem, for it is the Keter of the Tzadi of the Tzelem, as will be said, God willing.
